name: spec-clarify-plan-oracle
description: Read-only product workflow with a clarification gate before planning.

steps.task: Convert goal into a testable spec for: {goal}. Preserve original ask: {original_user_ask}.
steps.expectedOutcome: spec.v1 with acceptance criteria and open questions
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Review the prior spec for goal: {goal}. Score clarity and decide if planning is allowed. If clarity_score < 70 or BLOCKED, return allow_plan=no.
steps.expectedOutcome: clarification.v1 with clarity_score, verdict, allow_plan, questions, assumptions, and minimum_to_plan
mustDo: Block planning when acceptance criteria are not testable
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Plan only if clarification allows planning for goal: {goal}. Use prior spec/clarification evidence from: {previous_step_ids}. State assumptions and stop if allow_plan=no.
steps.expectedOutcome: Bounded plan or explicit stop decision if clarification blocks planning
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Review the clarification-gated plan for goal: {goal}. Return PASS/FAIL/WARN and no_ship without editing.
steps.expectedOutcome: Oracle verdict on whether the clarified plan is safe
mustDo: Check plan against spec and clarification
Flag missing validation or unsafe scope
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}
